info.name: Tournament Bracket API
info.description:
REST API for single-elimination tournaments (Laravel + PostgreSQL).

Run on a fresh database: `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`, then `php artisan serve`, then run the whole collection with the Collection Runner from top to bottom. Test scripts store created ids in collection variables. Error cases rely on seeded data (tournaments 1-3, teams 1-16).

item.name: Teams
item.description: Team CRUD, players of a team and match history.

request.description: Paginated list of teams. Filters: `search` (case-insensitive match on name or tag), `country` (ISO alpha-2). Pagination: `page`, `per_page` (1-100).

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Creates a team. `name` (required, max 50, unique), `tag` (required, 2-5 latin letters/digits, unique, uppercased automatically), `country` (optional ISO alpha-2). Stores the new id in `team_id`.
Returns a team with its players.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Partial update: only sent fields change. Same rules as create; uniqueness ignores the team itself.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Creates a player directly in the team. `nickname` (required, max 30, unique), `full_name` (optional, max 100), `role` (optional, max 30). Stores the new id in `player_id`.

response.name: 201 Created

request.description: Paginated players of the team.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Matches where the team plays as team1 or team2. Filters: `tournament_id`, `status` (pending, ready, completed, bye). Empty before the bracket is generated.
